parameters.base_gusset_weld: Shop CJP to shaft and base

connections.description: Machine a 2.7 m square blank from 21 longitudinal IS 2062 E250 B0 strips rolled from 130 or 190 mm plate, set on edge and cut to 470 mm finished depth. Seam centres stay at least 62 mm from each M64 anchor axis. Full-depth, equal-strength shop CJP butt splices under IS 800 10.5.7.1.2, 100% UT, weld procedure qualification, through-thickness ductility and toughness qualification for both axes, control of restraint and lamellar tearing, then finish machine. The shop must qualify this weldment and the foundation engineer must verify group anchorage and pedestal reinforcement before issue. Native SFRS base shear envelopes the factored frame shear, 1.2 times column shear capacity per IS 800 12.12.2, and IS 18168 9.3 fixed-base capacity actions. The model takes friction at 0.45 of bearing-block compression and the remaining resultant through the anchor group. The foundation designer must establish a concrete/group transfer path, grout shear and local reinforcement or provide a separately designed shear key. The indicated fusion zones need qualified shop procedures and full UT.
Both shafts CJP-welded to 45 mm division plate, matching electrode and full UT. Verify plate availability and through-thickness properties.

Full-depth, equal-strength shop CJP butt splices under IS 800 10.5.7.1.2, 100% UT, weld procedure qualification, through-thickness ductility and toughness qualification for both axes, control of restraint and lamellar tearing, then finish machine. The shop must qualify this weldment and the foundation engineer must verify group anchorage and pedestal reinforcement before issue. Native SFRS base shear envelopes the factored frame shear, 1.2 times column shear capacity per IS 800 12.12.2, and IS 18168 9.3 fixed-base capacity actions. The model takes friction at 0.45 of bearing-block compression and the remaining resultant through the anchor group. The foundation designer must establish a concrete/group transfer path, grout shear and local reinforcement or provide a separately designed shear key. The indicated fusion zones need qualified shop procedures and full UT.
Both shafts CJP-welded to 45 mm division plate, matching electrode and full UT. Verify plate availability and through-thickness properties.
